title: Make a failing CSV test suite pass
task:
`parseCSV` in `src/csv.js` splits on newlines and commas, so most of `test/csv.test.js` fails. Rewrite `parseCSV` so the whole suite passes. Do not edit the tests.

`parseCSV(text, { delimiter = ',' } = {})` returns an array of rows, each an array of strings, following RFC 4180:

- Fields may be wrapped in double quotes. Quoted fields can contain the delimiter, newlines, and escaped quotes written as `""`.
- Rows end with `\n` or `\r\n`. A single trailing line break does not create an extra empty row.
- Empty input (`''`) returns `[]`.
- Empty fields are kept as `''` (`'a,,c'` -> `[['a', '', 'c']]`). Whitespace around fields is preserved, not trimmed.
- The optional `delimiter` is a single character, e.g. `';'` or `'\t'`.
- An unterminated quoted field throws a `SyntaxError`.

Run the tests with `npm test`.
